prompt: Static camera. A huge reddish-brown monster is wedged through the already-broken wall of a cozy room, speaking angrily and comedically at a wooden desk. An open laptop sits on the desk in front of the monster, with its screen facing the monster. While speaking, the monster uses restrained, natural hand gestures above the desk and occasionally makes a clear pointing gesture toward the laptop screen for emphasis. The pointing does not need to be continuous; between pointing moments, the hand may relax or make small conversational gestures. The monster generally keeps its attention on the laptop while speaking into the black studio microphone. Its mouth moves naturally in precise sync with the speech, with expressive but controlled angry facial expressions, subtle head and eye movement, and occasional blinking. The monster's enormous torso stays nearly fixed in the wall opening without large body movement. The existing broken wall, wooden frame, laptop, microphone, desk, lamp, and background remain stable and unchanged, with no additional wall damage or falling debris.
